Trainer: Rewarding block on cleaning rounds at first light
Coordinator: The Companion Animal Travel Desk kept a steady pace through routine checks and careful note taking.
Planner: We confirmed kennel readiness, water access, and bedding condition before any traveler was brought forward.
Handler: The approach remained calm and humane, with slow movements and soft voice throughout each interaction.
Dispatcher: Emil Okafor and Gabriel Santos were both reviewed against their travel papers and animal care notes.
Records: Trixie was listed for standard observation, and her comfort markers stayed reassuring during the review.
Coordinator: Staff kept communication brief, clear, and respectful, which helped preserve a settled atmosphere.
Planner: Carrier latches, labels, and route tags were matched with the register without any irregularity.
Handler: The senior coordinator reminded the desk that patience is part of safe handling at Aurelia Skyways.
Records: I noted no distress signs beyond ordinary travel restlessness, and the animal settled well after reassessment.
Dispatcher: The handover remained orderly, and every document was returned to its proper file.
Coordinator: We continued with checks on feeding guidance, contact details, and destination notes in the usual manner.
Planner: The team used gentle restraint only where needed and always with attention to welfare.
Records: The Companion Animal Travel Desk maintained dependable service and a reassuring standard throughout the review.
